issue: Pagination is off by one. `page_count(total, per_page)` returns 3 for 20 items at 10 per page (should be 2), and 0 items is 0 pages. `page_slice(items, page, per_page)` uses 1-based pages but currently returns the wrong items for page 1. per_page < 1 raises ValueError in both.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

Pagination is off by one. `page_count(total, per_page)` returns 3 for 20 items at 10 per page (should be 2), and 0 items is 0 pages. `page_slice(items, page, per_page)` uses 1-based pages but currently returns the wrong items for page 1. per_page < 1 raises ValueError in both.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q`. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
